# SAIFU — Beijing Saifuliqi Technology Co., Ltd.

> AI video tools and custom AI video application development for creators, teams and businesses.

SAIFU (赛蚨里奇) is the brand of 北京赛蚨里奇科技有限公司, Beijing Saifuliqi Technology Co., Ltd. The official company website is https://saifuliqi.com/.

The company develops AI video generation and editing tools and purpose-built applications. Its stated work combines capability selection, product design, software development and workflow integration. Project scope, costs and timelines are discussed for the actual use case; this website does not publish a self-serve subscription or a public video-generation API.

## Company and services

- [English company overview](https://saifuliqi.com/en): AI video tools and application development.
- [Chinese company overview](https://saifuliqi.com/): 中文官网。
- [AI video tool development](https://saifuliqi.com/en/services/ai-video-tools): Generation, editing and creative workflow tools.
- [Custom AI video applications](https://saifuliqi.com/en/services/custom-ai-video-applications): Application design and workflow integration around a business use case.
- [中文：AI 视频工具开发](https://saifuliqi.com/services/ai-video-tools)
- [中文：定制 AI 视频应用](https://saifuliqi.com/services/custom-ai-video-applications)
